title: GatewayRepoAssessment.v1
description: Assessment of a gateway/discovery repo or browser runtime: its governance class (discovery_list = metadata only; self_hosted_gateway = lab candidate only; browser_agent_runtime = sandbox/runtime candidate, NOT an LLM endpoint; shared-key/bypass/reverse-engineered = quarantine), with the import/execution posture. No repo is imported or executed from this assessment; metadata only.

import_allowed.description: whether the repo may be imported into the codebase (always false for slice 1 — metadata only)
